subject: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantify.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lasker <jordan@quantify.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — Quantify's engineering team is ready to run one final set of latency and throughput sweeps before our pilot kickoff. We want to do a controlled 48–72 hour window of high-concurrency testing (to validate tail latency under sustained bursts) and we’re short on trial credits to complete the run.

Quick ask: could Redwood provide a temporary credit top-up (promo/one-off) to cover:
- ~250k token/day for 3 days (estimate: 750k tokens total)
- Sustained concurrency up to 180 req/s with 2k token average response

Attached is our POC plan with test cases and schedule. We can start as early as next Monday and will provide run logs and the post-test latency report.

Files: quantify_poc_plan.xlsx (attachment)

Let me know if you need more numbers or if you prefer we narrow the window.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Integrations | Quantify Labs
alyssa.turner@quantify.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantify.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request

Alyssa — thanks for the plan and the numbers, this is reasonable. A couple quick clarifying questions so we size the top-up correctly:
- Is the 2k token average for responses or includes prompt tokens?
- Do you need the tokens to be usable only in the hosted environment, or will the Dedicated trial also be used?
- Preferred start window (you mentioned next Monday) — confirm timezone and exact start time.

CC’ing Marissa (AE) and Priyom (SE) to keep everyone aligned. Priyom — can you review the test shape and confirm there aren’t any special model variants they need that would impact cost (e.g., long context 32k runs)?

If all looks good we’ll request an interim credit allocation and get back with exact amounts and expiry.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Lasker <jordan@quantify.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantify.ai>, ops@quantify.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request

Thanks Karthik — answers below so you have the full picture.

- Tokens: 2k average is response-only; prompt sizes are smaller (~300 tokens).
- Environment: We’ll run the stress sweep in the hosted sandbox you gave us for the trial; no Dedicated runs for this test.
- Start window: Monday 2026-12-07 at 07:00 PST, 48h sweep with a short 3rd day soak if everything looks clean.

We also attached a short runbook in Drive with the exact concurrency ramp steps and abort conditions: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QNT-poc-runbook

Let us know what you can provision — we’re flexible on the exact credit quantity if you’d rather ship a smaller top-up and we’ll throttle accordingly.

—Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering | Quantify Labs
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request

Karthik / team — reviewed the numbers and Quantify looks like a strategic pilot. Approving a conservative promotional top-up to cover the test window.

Approval summary (internal):
- Top-up: 150,000 token-equivalent credits allocated to Quantify trial account
- Expiry: 14 days from allocation date
- Notes: Ask SE to enable request-level throttles and prefix caching where applicable; collect KV cache metrics for post-mortem.

I’ve added a short approval note (approval_note.pdf) to the ticket. If the run shows we underprovision, we can grant an incremental buffer but only after reviewing the first 12 hours of telemetry.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantify.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC load sweep - short credit top-up request

Alyssa — good news: we approved a short, conservative top-up to get the sweep done. Details below: 

- Allocated credits: 150,000 token-equivalent credits applied to your trial account (Quantify Labs)
- Expiry: 2026-12-16T23:59:00-08:00 (14 days from allocation)
- Usage controls: We’ve enabled request-level throttling and a canary ramp plan; Priyom will coordinate the ramp and watch tail latency.

Next steps:
1) Priyom to schedule a 30-minute pre-run check-in with Quantify ops (I’ll let him reach out).
2) Start window confirmed for 2026-12-07 07:00 PST (Jordan/Alyssa).
3) If telemetry indicates we need more headroom, we’ll consider a short incremental top-up after the first 12 hours — need SE signoff and Ben’s confirmation.

Attached: topup_receipt_20261202.pdf (server-side reference). We’ll also post the run logs and latency report to the shared drive link after the sweep.

Alyssa, if this setup works for you I’ll mark the request closed on our side and hand off to Priyom.

Thanks everyone.
—Karthik
